purpose: Separate analytic complexity, operator kernels, full-model runtime, online serving, energy, memory, and monetary cost while preserving the failed v1 proxy control envelope.

proxy_control_envelope_audit.gpu_hour_definition: total active_seconds divided by 3600, including startup, compilation, validation, training, and checkpoint work on the occupied GPU
proxy_control_envelope_audit.decision: the dense control fails the complete v1 proxy hard envelope in all three cells solely on total GPU-hours; the 1.0-hour limit is not widened or redefined
proxy_control_envelope_audit.scope: this is a negative cost-envelope result, not a quality failure and not a reason to stop the already frozen fixed-sample proxy
proxy_control_envelope_audit.successor_rule: any future absolute runtime envelope is a versioned prospective resource decision justified from these observations, never a relabeling of v1 as passed

evidence_hierarchy.measures: closed-form parameters, arithmetic FLOPs, communication bytes, and persistent-state bytes
evidence_hierarchy.cannot_claim: realized speed, energy, capacity, or dollar savings

evidence_hierarchy.measures: isolated reference/kernel latency, throughput, workspace, numerical error, and roofline behavior
complete training step, prefill, decode, state transition, compile, and peak-memory behavior
scheduler, continuous batching, prefix reuse, arrival-rate saturation, latency distributions, failures, and output throughput
evidence_hierarchy.cannot_claim: portable monetary cost without explicit accounting inputs

evidence_hierarchy.measures: hardware amortization or cloud price plus measured gross/incremental energy under one named deployment
evidence_hierarchy.cannot_claim: cost on unmeasured hardware, utilization, region, contract, or electricity assumptions

training_measurement.primary: paired GPU seconds to a control-only locked quality target
secondary: model FLOP utilization with stated peak denominator
gross and incremental joules to quality
training_measurement.rule: steady training excludes startup, validation, checkpoint, and orchestration, but total occupied GPU time reports them all; neither may be substituted for the other
training_measurement.utilization: report SM/memory utilization samples and operator time; analytic FLOPs times throughput alone is not a hardware-utilization diagnosis

energy_measurement.sampler: NVML or nvidia-smi bound to exact GPU UUID with monotonic timestamps
energy_measurement.gross_energy_joules: trapezoidal integral of board power watts over each named interval
energy_measurement.idle_baseline: five thermally matched idle blocks before/after the experiment with display and background workload recorded
energy_measurement.incremental_energy_joules: gross energy minus elapsed seconds times paired idle-baseline watts
energy_measurement.missing_samples: report count, longest gap, and bounded energy interval using neighboring/minimum/maximum power; do not interpolate an unbounded outage
energy_measurement.cpu_and_host: report separately when measured; GPU board power alone is not whole-system energy

loads: maximum resident batch at 524288 cached token slots
online arrival rates at 10, 30, 50, 70, and 90 percent of measured saturation
cache_conditions: partial prefix hit with unfinished-tail recomputation
metrics: input and output tokens per GPU-second
request failure, timeout, and cancellation rate
gross/incremental joules per input and output token
serving_matrix.rule: report every shape/load/path separately; a prefill-only or maximum-batch win cannot be presented as batch-1 decode or online-service improvement

memory_accounting: resident model weights by dense, recurrent, attention, residual, router, shared, and routed-expert category
optimizer states, gradients, and master weights
persistent exact/compressed/sparse/local KV plus quantization scales and metadata
fixed recurrent KDA state and convolution history
expert activation, dispatch, and communication buffers
allocated versus reserved bytes and allocator fragmentation
host-pinned, pageable CPU, and disk/prefix-cache state

statistical_controls.microbenchmark: at least five thermally interleaved candidate/control blocks and 30 measured iterations per block
statistical_controls.online: at least 1000 requests for p99 with deterministic request trace replay and paired bootstrap confidence intervals
statistical_controls.failure_retention: OOM, timeout, dropped request, compiler fallback, and numerical failure remain in denominators and artifacts

hardware_inputs: purchase price or exact cloud SKU/region/contract price
monetary_accounting.cloud_rule: do not add owned-hardware amortization to a cloud hourly price that already bundles hardware; report cloud and owned scenarios separately
monetary_accounting.current_status: blocked because v1 contains neither hardware amortization nor electricity price
monetary_accounting.fallback: report physical time, energy, and memory separately; do not fabricate dollars

datacenter_v2_requirements: exact accelerator SKU/count/memory and node CPU/RAM
driver, CUDA, libraries, compiler, serving runtime, and container hashes
scheduler, batching, cache, eviction, and failure-recovery policy
training and serving request shapes plus hard latency/capacity envelopes
power telemetry scope and monetary inputs
absolute experiment resource and failure-recovery budget

decision.next_action: retain the v1 control failure; after the fixed proxy completes, report candidate/control physical cost descriptively and freeze a prospective v2 finalist/datacenter envelope before any larger run
